posts.t: Lost in a lot of the post-Tkachuk revenge commotion, Linus Ullmark is on injured reserve. #Sens.
After a quick hug with Linus Ullmark, Lars Eller catches up with Tim Stützle.

Respect Travis Green for going with Ullmark tonight. Would be easy from a human element perspective to go to Ersson against his former club. He's going with his no. 1 guy to try and take advantage of a struggling Flyers team.
